title: Woman Finds Hidden Camera in Her Store's Bathroom
description:
A mall employee in Miami-Dade County was arrested after his co-workers allegedly found a pen camera pointed at the toilet in the store’s bathroom. Police took Bernardo Pellicer-Dorta, 38, into custody after reviewing the camera’s footage, which allegedly showed him searching for a place to stash the camera until one woman found it and kept it away from him. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
